query: New York COVID-19 weekly cases deaths hospitalizations January 2024 site:health.ny.gov OR site:nyc.gov
query_rationale: Directly targets NYSDOH (health.ny.gov) and NYC DOHMH (nyc.gov) official surveillance pages for COVID-19 weekly data in January 2024. These agencies publish weekly COVID-19 reports with confirmed cases, deaths, and hospitalizations broken down by date and geography. Using site: operators maximizes precision for official New York public health sources.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: Official NYSDOH or NYC DOHMH weekly COVID-19 surveillance report or dashboard page for January 2024
expected_trust_signal: Government domain (.ny.gov or nyc.gov), official agency authorship, dated weekly report

query: CDC COVID Data Tracker New York State cases deaths hospitalizations week January 2024
query_rationale: CDC COVID Data Tracker (cdc.gov) is the primary federal aggregator of state-level COVID-19 surveillance data including confirmed cases, deaths, and hospitalizations. It covers New York State and publishes weekly metrics. This query targets the CDC tracker specifically for New York in January 2024, which is likely to yield case counts, death counts, and hospitalization admissions for the target week.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC COVID Data Tracker state-level weekly summary for New York, January 2024
expected_trust_signal: Federal government domain (cdc.gov), CDC authorship, weekly epidemiological data

query: New York COVID-19 cases deaths hospitalizations "January 2024" weekly surveillance report NYSDOH OR "New York State Department of Health"

The phrase 'January 2024' and 'weekly surveillance report' anchor the time window and report type. Including the full agency name increases recall for official documents.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: NYSDOH weekly COVID-19 surveillance bulletin or press release for the week of January 1–7, 2024
expected_trust_signal: NYSDOH authorship, official report title, dated January 2024

expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article or situation report citing New York COVID-19 weekly statistics for early January 2024, with direct quotes from official data
expected_trust_signal: Established news outlet, citation of official NYSDOH or CDC figures, publication date in January 2024

expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC Socrata open data dataset page or API endpoint for weekly COVID-19 cases and deaths by state, with a New York row for week ending January 6 or January 7, 2024
expected_trust_signal: Federal government domain (data.cdc.gov), CDC authorship, Socrata structured dataset with state-level weekly rows

expected_trust_signal: New York State government domain (health.data.ny.gov), NYSDOH authorship, open data portal with time-series dataset

query: New York COVID-19 "week ending January 6" OR "week ending January 7" 2024 cases deaths hospitalizations
query_rationale: The standard CDC and NYSDOH reporting convention uses 'week ending [date]' with the Saturday end-date. For the 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-07 window, the week-ending date is January 6 (Saturday) or January 7 (Sunday, depending on the reporting convention). News articles and situation reports from early January 2024 citing official figures often use this exact phrase. This query uses exact phrase matching for both possible week-ending dates to maximize recall of news articles that cite official New York COVID-19 figures for the target week, which can provide evidence quotes and corroborate official data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News article or public health situation report from January 2024 citing New York COVID-19 weekly statistics with 'week ending January 6' or 'week ending January 7' language, including numeric case, death, or hospitalization figures
expected_trust_signal: Established news outlet or official agency press release, publication date in January 2024, direct citation of NYSDOH or CDC figures
